summary.text: Ellen Troxclair is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 19 since January 10, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served on the Austin City Council from 2015 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Ellen Troxclair was born in Texas and works as a realtor.
She was one of ten new Austin City Council members elected in the city's first district-based election in 2014, and she represented District 8 from 2015 to 2019.
Troxclair succeeded James White in the Texas House, and her current term ends on January 12, 2027.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner, non-profit leader and mother, and said she was known on the city council as a budget watchdog.
She listed securing the border and stopping illegal immigration, election integrity, lowering property taxes, and supporting small business owners among her policy interests in that survey.
